I did read about the sulphur smell prior to buying, but I did not realize that the smell lingers even after washing your face a couple of times. Not my favorite mask. Lastly, the fizzing of the mask makes my face tickle so bad, but this one is on me and not necessarily the products fault.

Ive been using this product consistently for about 3 months, 2-3 times a week. It has not helped with my blackheads whatsoever. At first it makes your skin tingle. The smell is similar to the egg smell that well water has at times. It foams up really nice and when i wash it off it makes my face feel clean, but it dries out my skin and doesnt help my blackheads.

I am not going to lie, it smells as sulfur smells…what a shock (sarcasm)! The bottle does say the active ingredient is sulfur so i understand the smell is not for everyone, but it is not as pungent as sulfur gases…it is tolerable and light. The feeling of the mask, when on your troubled areas of the face, feels fizzy, slight tingle (not burning), like tiny bubbles popping, and kinda cool! It does start to fizz the moment it is on your face and stays fizzy for the most part the entire 3-5minutes. You do not need to cake it on either for it to fizz and feel like its cleaning your face. Rinse it well and I used warm water and a rag since it does feel like a cream coming off your face when wet. Once done and you dried your face, your face will have a hint of sulfur smell still, not going to lie there either. However, your face will feel so clean and soft. I have used it twice so far and I think it has tamed the congestion on my skin, the deep cystic acne on my jawline, and the tiny black heads on my side of the nose. Time will tell if it is a placebo or works past the two uses. I would recommend it still to anyone who likes the brand and needs a good face cleaning!

My ride and die product helps w my pores and fast, makes my skin feel new! Definitely would only put where you want to target pores. I love this mask such a cool experience as well w the fizz. Take like 5-8 mins to unfizz and dimish. Then u wash and pretty skin

I have type 2 rosacea and I use use this mask 2 times a week. It helps to calm any flair ups and keeps my skin clear for the most part. It also helps to keep congestion under control and does not irritate my sensitive skin. Rosacea is such a hard condition to manage and this product was a great find.

avis.titre: It works! Must use once a week at least

The smell stayed with me for hours. I pretty confident I won't use it again.

This stuff saved my skin. I consistently use it three times a week and I noticed results after about two weeks.
